scope: POSTHOC oracle capacity audit on eight ALREADY-USED multiscale 2D Helmholtz DEV systems. Read TRUE test speed at grid65, Euclidean-project into speed PCA rank64/128/256 trained on512 medium labels, spline to grid257 and physically solve the two query fields. Include full true-grid65 interpolation as a floor. All methods READ TRUE TEST MEDIUM and are NONDEPLOYABLE; Euclidean projection is not the best response lower bound. Purpose is to interpret the rank64 local sparse-response information audit, not a learned-method score or independent test.
